title: Visits Still to Be Drawn Before an Insured Plan of Care Authorization Ends
content:
**Decision table — Insured Plan of Care.** From the authorized visits not yet drawn on the current authorization, those still to be drawn before the authorization ends are taken off first, before the remainder is carried into the coming period:

| The plan's active Appointment Series | Visits still to be drawn |
|---|---|
| Ends on or before the authorization's end date | The appointments booked on that series less those attended, cancelled, recorded as no-shows or released |
| Runs past the authorization's end date | The active series' visits per week times the days from today to the authorization's end date, divided by seven with any fraction dropped |
| Otherwise (no active series) | None |

The bookings, attendances, cancellations, no-shows and releases are read from the Appointment Series history; the days from today to the end date count today as day zero. What remains carried is never below zero.

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-05-05, authorization ends 2026-05-20)

1. Active series ends 2026-05-15; 12 appointments booked, 8 attended, 1 cancelled, 0 no-shows, 0 released: 3 still to be drawn.
2. Active series ends 2026-06-30 at 3 visits per week; 15 days from today to 2026-05-20: 3 times 15 divided by 7 is 6.43, fraction dropped, 6 still to be drawn.
3. No active series: none.

With 3 visits not yet drawn and 6 still to be drawn, nothing is carried into the period.
